title: LSD could be approved for anxiety in the US in 2027 | New Scientist
description: The psychedelic drug LSD eased anxiety in a late-stage trial, paving the way for a probable approval in the US within the next two years
author: Carissa Wong

title: One of the fundamental forces is stronger than we thought | New Scientist
description: The most precise calculation yet of the electroweak force could help fix cracks in the standard model of particle physics
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: Reading for pleasure boosts memory, empathy and mental health | New Scientist
description: Fewer people are reading for pleasure, but getting lost in a good book has repeatedly been linked to substantial cognitive benefits
author: Clarissa Brincat

title: Brain implant lets people with paralysis speak and gesture at the same time | New Scientist
description: Previous brain implants have enabled people with paralysis to either speak or move, but a new, larger one let them do both simultaneously via an avatar
author: Carissa Wong

title: Jet-powered drones pose a new threat to Ukraine – can they be stopped? | New Scientist
description: Ukraine is racing to design faster, more capable interceptor drones to tackle Russia's new generation of jet-powered Shahed attack drones
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Scientists call for ‘emergency’ measures to save sea life from El Niño | New Scientist
description: Reducing fishing quotas, rescuing endangered species from the water and testing geoengineering could help soften ocean heat impacts from the record El Niño, some oceanographers argue
author: Alec Luhn
